comments.note: GridPagination uses constructor property promotion (private DataGridInterface $grid) while GridActions uses explicit assignment. Purely stylistic inconsistency, no functional impact.
DataGrid::actions() uses isset($this->actions) while generateOutput() uses $this->actions !== null. Plan step 14 scoped the unification to generateOutput() only, which is satisfied.

PAGE_SENTINEL is a 12-digit numeric constant (999_999_999_999) rather than the non-numeric string suggested in the plan. Acceptable deviation — practically collision-free and the getPageURLTemplate() correctly replaces it with '{PAGE}'.
StandardRow::getGrid() has a covariant return type (DataGrid not DataGridInterface). Pre-existing design choice documented in api-surface.md.

Example 3-grid-actions.php calls $grid->actions()->processSubmittedActions() directly rather than $grid->processActions(). Both work correctly due to idempotency guard, but the example could showcase the preferred API.
The 14 PHPStan errors are all pre-existing (stubs, missing abstract methods on non-abstract classes, typing gaps) and documented in constraints.md.
